title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-115-26二模

items.zh: 干了一整天的活儿,回到家我只想躺着不动。
items.en: After working all day, I just feel like lying motionless at home.

items.zh: 所有新药必须接受严格检测,未经批准不得发布。
items.en: All new drugs must undergo rigorous testing and shall not be released without approval.

items.zh: 他打开那本布满灰尘的相册时,脑海中突然浮现出三十年前在家乡拍下这些照片的场景。
items.en: When he opened the dusty photo album, the scene of taking these photos in his hometown thirty years ago suddenly occurred to him.

items.zh: 在城市文化展上,面对外国朋友的浓厚兴趣,志愿者们耐心讲解并亲自示范中国书法，成功推广了这一传统艺术。
items.en: At the Urban Culture Exhibition, faced with the keen interest shown by foreign visitors, the volunteers patiently explained the basics and personally demonstrated Chinese calligraphy, which successfully promoted this traditional art.
